steps: Submit original video inline to Router with host description
Persist request ID and poll status/get
Review transcript, speaker labels and second-based timing
Submit selected non-overlapping host lines with saved voice reference
Tempo-fit cloned lines and mix over original soundtrack only in reviewed intervals
Copy generated video stream without re-encoding; save a separate private dubbed result
limitations: Ambient audio within replaced intervals is also replaced
Video duration must match source within 350 milliseconds
Voice line fit is limited to one-third to three times playback speed
